before.available_fallback: Some English captions and browser visuals; documented limitations.

change.collector: Continue downloader errors, retain actual usable media, mark remaining errors partial.
change.reader: Narrow subtitle languages; optional local ASR when subtitles are unavailable.

after.fresh_chat_cache_reuse: Recorded in the private activation verification notes.

regression.type: simulated downloader; not a live rate-limit test
regression.assertion: Usable media survives and retrieval remains partial when subtitle errors are present.

limitations: One live recovery example, not general platform reliability.
A successful retry does not prove every fallback branch occurred.
Saved statuses are historical; this portfolio build did not re-download the posts.
public_redaction: Raw downloader diagnostics, paths, media, and full subtitles omitted.
